text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pediatric patient presenting with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand the severity of your condition, I need to ask you a few questions. First, can you describe the pain in your legs? Is it constant, or does it get worse with movement or at night?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)

The combination of bone pain, fever, easy bruising, and blood work showing low platelets with high white blood cells is classic for leukemia. I have requested an X-ray to rule out other causes, but based on this evidence, your primary concern is likely blood cancer. Do you have any known contact with someone who recently received a cancer diagnosis?
